suppress.notes: CVE-2026-44891, CVE-2026-55831, CVE-2026-55833 were fixed in io.netty 4.2.16.Final per the Netty security release notes (https://netty.io/news/2026/07/06/4-2-16-Final.html). This is a false positive caused by NVD not yet reflecting the patched version range. Re-evaluate when NVD data is updated.

Spring Framework 6.2.x is EOL with no public fix for these CVEs. Fixed in Spring Framework 7.0.9 (Spring Boot 4.0.8+). Upgrading to Spring Boot 4.x is required for a public OSS fix. CVE-2026-59313: Stream corruption when using SSE with the functional web framework. CVE-2026-59314: HTTP response splitting via Content-Disposition from untrusted filename input. See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59313 See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59314

Spring Framework 6.2.x is EOL with no public fix for these CVEs. Fixed in Spring Framework 7.0.9 (Spring Boot 4.0.8+). Upgrading to Spring Boot 4.x is required for a public OSS fix. CVE-2026-47892, CVE-2026-47893, CVE-2026-59280, CVE-2026-59283: Various Spring Framework vulnerabilities. See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-47892 See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-47893 See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59280 See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59283

Spring Cloud Commons 4.3.x has no public fix for CVE-2026-59284. Upgrading to a later version with a public OSS fix is required. CVE-2026-59284: Spring Cloud Commons vulnerability. See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59284

CVE-2026-59270 affects Spring Security's embedded UnboundID LDAP server (UnboundIdContainer). This application does not use the embedded LDAP server. For Spring Security 7.0.x: a fix is available in 7.0.7 — consider upgrading from 7.0.2 to 7.0.7. For Spring Security 6.5.x (transitive spring-security-crypto): 6.5.x is EOL with no OSS fix. See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59270

CVE-2026-59354 affects the spring-security-oauth2-authorization-server module (7.0.0-7.0.4) only, when Dynamic Client Registration is explicitly enabled. This application does not use the OAuth2 Authorization Server module, so this is a false positive for all reported jars. Fixed in spring-security-oauth2-authorization-server 7.0.5. See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59354
